name: LPAQA
description: LPAQA is a benchmark suite designed to evaluate the knowledge contained in language models by automatically generating high-quality and diverse prompts to query relational knowledge, improving over manually created prompts.
reputation: LPAQA is a well-known prompt-generation benchmark for probing relational knowledge in language models and is commonly used in knowledge probing research.
notes: Improves accuracy on the LAMA benchmark from 31.1% to 39.6% by generating better prompts; provides a tighter lower bound on LM knowledge.
